fields.FIR_Description: During the night of 2025-09-05, around 23:00, a group of persons allegedly attacked Abirami Sri at Poongodi Layout Residential Colony in Tiruppur, causing injuries that required treatment, according to the complaint recorded on 2025-09-05. Bharathi Raman (9000000104) reported the matter for Abirami Sri, whose contact number is given as 9000000096. Sanjay Mani (9000000120), described as a co-worker, was also mentioned in the complaint. A person named Karthik Velan, associated with the number 9000000188, was mentioned as potentially relevant to the incident. Potentially relevant material referenced includes CCTV footage and physical documents.
fields.Modus_Operandi: Several persons reportedly attacked the victim in a secluded stretch.
